title: Saudi Arabian Snow Peas Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from Saudi Arabia, made with snow peas and a blend of warming spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the snow peas, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, salt, and black pepper.
Stir in the Arabian tagine spice blend.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10-12 minutes or until the snow peas are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
